name: Raise (FD, 8-bit sum): any car (raw messages)
description: Raise box with the FD framing (FD LEN CMD data CS, LEN = data + 3, CS = LEN + CMD + data), no acknowledgement, hello 81 01 at the start as the PSA Raise profiles do. Any car: no decoding, raw messages. Also the description of this box type ("box": "raise-fd").
